'''Justo Ruiz González''' (born 31 August 1969) is a former professional [[Association football|footballer]] who played as a [[midfielder]].

In a 21-year senior career, his professional input consisted of 62 [[Segunda División]] games with [[Athletic Bilbao B|Bilbao Athletic]] and [[SD Eibar|Eibar]] and 23 in the Portuguese [[Liga Portugal 2|Segunda Liga]] with [[C.F. União|União da Madeira]].

Starting in 2008, Ruiz worked as [[Manager (association football)|manager]] of the [[Andorra national under-21 football team|Andorra under-21 national team]] for 11 years.

==Club career==
Ruiz was born in [[Vitoria-Gasteiz]], [[Basque Country (autonomous community)|Basque Country]]. After five years in the Spanish [[Segunda División]], four with [[Athletic Bilbao]]'s [[Athletic Bilbao B|reserves]] and one with [[SD Eibar]], he continued his career in the lower leagues, including three seasons with [[FC Andorra]] (who competed in the Spanish system).<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.diariovasco.com/bajo-deba/eibar/exarmero-rige-deporte-20220915215315-ntvo.html|title=Un exarmero rige el deporte de Andorra|trans-title=Former ''armero'' in charge of sports in Andorra|newspaper=[[El Diario Vasco]]|first=J. A.|last=Rementería|language=es|date=15 September 2022|access-date=12 November 2025}}</ref> In [[1998–99 Segunda Divisão de Honra|1998–99]], he represented [[C.F. União]] in Portugal's [[Liga Portugal 2|Segunda Liga]].<ref name=Wave>{{cite news|url=https://www.publico.pt/1998/12/28/jornal/a-primeira-vaga-121301|title=A primeira vaga|trans-title=The first wave|newspaper=[[Público (Portugal)|Público]]|first=Dulce|last=Furtado|language=pt|date=28 December 1998|access-date=30 August 2019}}</ref>

The following summer, aged 30, Ruiz moved back to FC Andorra,<ref name=Wave/> and spent the remainder of his career in [[Andorra|the country]], competing well into his 30s with [[FC Rànger's]] of the microstate's [[Primera Divisió]], with whom he signed in 2004. Starting in 2011 and for five years, he acted as manager of the former club,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.andorradifusio.ad/esports/lfc-andorra-renova-justo-ruiz-com-entrenador|title=L'FC Andorra renova a Justo Ruíz com a entrenador|trans-title=FC Andorra renew Justo Ruíz as manager|publisher=Andorra Difusió|language=ca|date=11 June 2014|access-date=30 August 2019}}</ref> resigning from his position in September 2016 alongside his entire staff.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.elperiodic.ad/noticia/53950/el-cos-tecnic-de-lfc-andorra-dimiteix-en-bloc|title=El cos tècnic de l'FC Andorra dimiteix en bloc|trans-title=The FC Andorra coaching staff resigns as a whole|newspaper=[[El Periòdic d'Andorra]]|first=Joan Josep|last=Blasco|language=ca|date=1 October 2016|access-date=30 August 2019}}</ref>

==International career==
Ruiz won 21 [[Cap (sport)|caps]] for [[Spain national football team|Spain]] across five [[Spain national youth football team|youth levels]]. He appeared with the [[Spain national under-20 football team|under-20 side]] at the [[1989 FIFA World Youth Championship]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.cuadernosdefutbol.com/2014/12/espana-en-los-mundiales-sub20-arabia-saudita-1989/|title=España en los mundiales sub’20: Arabia Saudita 1989|trans-title=Spain in the under'20 World Cups: Saudi Arabia 1989|publisher=Cuadernos de Fútbol|first=Óscar|last=Díez|language=es|date=1 December 2014|access-date=12 November 2025}}</ref>

In 1996, Ruiz began representing the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra senior team]]. He played a total of 21 [[FIFA World Cup qualification]] games for his adopted country, making his last competitive appearance on 21 November 2007 against [[Russia national football team|Russia]] at the age of 38 years and two months.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rsssf.org/miscellaneous/justoruiz-intl.html|title=Justo Ruiz González – International Appearances|publisher=[[RSSSF]]|first=Roberto|last=Mamrud|access-date=3 June 2016}}</ref>

For several years, Ruiz worked as manager of the [[Andorra national under-21 football team|Andorran under-21s]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.bondia.ad/esports/ruiz-es-posiciona-continuar-les-banquetes-de-lfc-andorra-i-la-sub-21|title=Ruiz es posiciona per continuar a les banquetes de l'FC Andorra i la sub-21|trans-title=Ruiz positioned to remain on FC Andorra and under-21 benches|newspaper=[[Bondia (newspaper)|Bondia]]|language=ca|date=18 June 2012|access-date=30 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://elperiodic.ad/entrevista/justo-ruiz-09-02-2016/|title=JUSTO RUIZ Al vestidor de l’ FC Andorra algú em tracta d’il·lustríssim|trans-title=JUSTO RUIZ In the FC Andorra locker room some address me as your greatness|newspaper=El Periòdic d'Andorra|language=ca|date=9 February 2016|access-date=12 November 2025}}</ref> He left his post in October 2019, after being named Secretary of State for Sports.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rtva.ad/ca/esports/futbol/eloy-casals-nou-seleccionador-sub-21|title=Eloy Casals, nou seleccionador sub-21|trans-title=Eloy Casals, new under-21 national team manager|publisher=[[Radio and Television of Andorra]]|first=Joel|last=Romero|language=es|date=30 October 2019|access-date=12 November 2025}}</ref>
